headline: Review of a cluster subdivision and Rural Farm zoning district density, plus the 2026 annual report.
summary: A cluster subdivision and Rural Farm zoning district density are up for review. Draft versions of the 2026 annual report will be reviewed and voted on, along with Maine Office of Community Affairs comments on the comprehensive plan.
items: 2026 annual report: review of draft versions and vote to approve
